set.name: orders_app
set.description: The Verinoda end-to-end example (examples/orders_app): framework-free HTTP handlers -> service -> pricing / repository -> SQLite, env configuration, pytest tests and one ADR. 10 questions: where x3, flow x2, config, tests, why, impact, behaviour.
set.gold_verified_by: Gold facts were written by reading every file of examples/orders_app line by line; each fact's source.at/source.contains pair is re-checked against the benchmark copy before any approach is scored (metrics.validate_gold).

provenance.questions_written_by: benchmark harness author (an agent, round 1), before any approach was run on the set
provenance.gold_written_by: same author, by reading every file of examples/orders_app
provenance.caveat: Verinoda has been developed against this example since round 1 (every track checks it), so Verinoda results on it are in-sample; questions and gold have not changed since 05890a1

verinoda_analyze.budget: config defaults (60 s, 40 tool calls, 6000 tokens)

llm.status: not measured: llm='none' (use --llm anthropic with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set)

raw.note: no index; every query greps and reads the working tree

verinoda.what: workflow.scan = Graphify-derived AST index (in-process) + snapshot (file hashes) + stale-claim check; warm = same tree again with the AST cache present
